text: Maintenance Log — Pump P-101. On 2024-03-12 the shift engineer A. Kumar reported abnormal vibration and a bearing temperature of 85 C on centrifugal pump P-101 in Unit 2. The mechanical seal was found leaking. Work order WO-4471 was raised requiring bearing replacement per procedure MP-07. Discharge pressure had dropped to 6 bar against a rated 12 bar.

Boiler B-2 annual inspection report. The pressure vessel was inspected under PESO regulations and IS 2825. Safety relief valve SRV-12 was tested at set pressure 10.5 bar. Refractory lining showed minor cracking. Inspector: R. Mehta, dated 2024-06-01. Next hydrotest due 2025-06-01.

From: plant.head@acme.com
To: maintenance@acme.com
Subject: Compressor C-3 trip
Date: 2024-05-20

Compressor C-3 tripped twice last night on high discharge temperature. Please inspect the intercooler and check the lube oil pressure. Raise a work order and follow OISD-116 for the fire safety review of the compressor house.
